# Helper Functions

```{r}
source("./simulation_helpers.R")
```

# Generate Data

```{r}
set.seed(2024)
all_checkers <- list()

trials <- 20
noise_levels <- c(3)
extra_dims <- c(0, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000)

i <- 1
for(trial in 1:trials) {
  for (noise_level in noise_levels) {
    for (extra_dim in extra_dims) {
      all_checkers[[i]] <- gen_checkerboard(
        100,
        100,
        5,
        5,
        noise = noise_level,
        cluster_spread = 10,
        p_extra = extra_dim,
        prob_empty = 0
      )
      all_checkers[[i]]$noise_level = noise_level
      all_checkers[[i]]$extra_dim = extra_dim
      all_checkers[[i]]$trial = trial
      i <- i + 1
    }
  }
}

```

```{r}
se_filtered <- function(vals) {
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  mean((vals - mean(vals))^2) / sqrt(length(vals))
}

se <- function(vals) {
  mean((vals - mean(vals))^2) / sqrt(length(vals))
}

mean_filtered <- function(vals) {
  mean(vals[is.finite(vals)])
}

all_results[all_results == -1] = NA

squash_trials <- all_results |>
  group_by(p, algorithm) |>
  # summarise(across(row_group_count:true_err, list(mean=mean, se=se)))
  summarise(across(feature_recall:adjusted.rand_col_true, list(mean=mean_filtered, se=se_filtered)))
# 
# ggplot(squash_trials, aes(x=p, y=largest_group_in_untrue_mean, color=algorithm)) +

ggplot(squash_trials, aes(x=p, y=adjusted.rand_row_mean, color=algorithm)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = adjusted.rand_row_mean - 1.96*adjusted.rand_row_se,

ggplot(squash_trials, aes(x=p, y=adjusted.rand_col_true_mean, color=algorithm)) +

ggplot(squash_trials, aes(x=p, y=feature_auc_mean, color=algorithm)) +
```
